title: Meeting the Bali bombing leader, who believed the Protocols
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Meeting the Bali bombing leader, who believed the Protocols, about 2002 bombings; meeting later at Indonesia (disaster zone), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> so I mean this stuff is there. Uh I was met a terrorist the leader the guy who created the Bali bombings in 2002.

plain: Peter Levenda is a writer and researcher of hidden history. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says he once met, in Indonesia, the man who led the 2002 bombings on the island of Bali. Levenda says this man believed in the Protocols of the Elders of Zion, an old pamphlet that claims to reveal a secret Jewish plan to rule the world. He tells it to show how strongly writings like this can still shape people today.
